obernants.operator: Time quantities carry seconds multiplier; frequencies carry cycles/second. First numbered frequency times first numbered duration yields cycles; without duration the period is reciprocal frequency. Target conversion uses first unnumbered duration unit and sum of all numbered durations. Mean month/year seconds are fixed constants, not civil interval lengths.

obernants.operator: number_word lowercases, rejects a/an and numeric digits, recursively adds hyphen-separated known words. Internal number accepts comma-stripped f64 or table entries including a/an. quantities splits hyphens, so twenty-four hours uses four. No full compositional English number parser is claimed.

obernants.operator: First numeric word in 1583..9999 is inspected only when whole-word leap or year occurs. Gregorian leap predicate is divisible by 4 except centuries unless divisible by 400. Clock fires on now/today or substring what time; local seconds = now as i64 + 3600*tz. Test domain keeps arithmetic in range.

obernants.operator: expect_after considers adjacent original pairs whose first event matches and second is neither message nor task; it does not reconnect across excluded events. Each group has floor(1000*n/N) and upper median of saturating time gaps. Sort descending probability then lexical event. Frequencies may sum below 1000.

obernants.operator: Recall uses first supplied matching event, fixed EVENTS order, lowercased alphanumeric words with optional trailing s, and saturating age. Future timestamp yields zero age; nonpositive elapsed duration omits took. All histories differing after first matched event remain compatible.

obernants.operator: activate recognizes EVENTS, gets now, sanitizes tab/newline, truncates detail to 200 Unicode characters and best-effort appends; Task drop invokes task activation with Instant elapsed. episodes reads/reverses/truncates physical rows, not timestamp sorting. fire performs per-event reads then clock/timezone reads, so its input is not an atomic snapshot. This typed effect relation is unexecuted by bounded tests.
